text: Lumen Bikes opens its workshop at 8:00 and closes it at 17:00 on weekdays. Core hours, when everyone must be reachable, run from 10:00 to 15:00. Staff who work from home on a given day must tell their team lead by 9:00 that morning. The workshop is closed on public holidays and on the last Friday of every year.

Every employee earns 22 days of paid leave per calendar year. Leave that is not used can be carried over to the next year, up to 5 days. Requests for more than 3 consecutive days must be submitted at least 14 days in advance. Sick leave does not count against paid leave, but a doctor's note is required after 2 days of absence.

Travel for work is booked through the office manager. Train tickets are reimbursed in second class only. Meals on business trips are reimbursed up to 25 euros per day. Receipts must be submitted within 30 days, or the claim expires.

Each employee receives a laptop after the probation period of 3 months. It must be returned on the last working day. Lost or stolen devices must be reported to the IT desk within 24 hours. Personal software may not be installed on company laptops.

The Lumen Rider 2 uses a removable 500 Wh battery. It takes about 4 hours to charge fully with the supplied charger. Typical range is 80 km on the eco setting and 45 km on the turbo setting. Charge the battery indoors at a temperature between 10 and 30 degrees Celsius.

The Rider 2 has hydraulic disc brakes on both wheels. The pads should be inspected every 1,000 km and replaced when thinner than 1.5 mm. The recommended tyre pressure is 3.5 bar for the front wheel and 4 bar for the rear wheel. Check the pressure at least once a month.

Service the bike at an authorised workshop once a year or every 2,500 km, whichever comes first. Clean the chain with a dry cloth and apply lubricant every 300 km. Never clean the bike with a high pressure washer, because water can damage the motor and the battery contacts. Software updates for the display are installed by the workshop during the yearly service.

If the display shows error E04, the motor sensor is not connected properly and the bike should be taken to a workshop. If the motor does not assist at all, check that the battery is locked in place and charged above 10 percent. A flashing battery icon means the charge is below 5 percent. The assist switches off by itself at 25 km/h, which is a legal limit and cannot be changed.

The frame of every Lumen bike is covered for 5 years from the date of purchase. The motor and the display are covered for 2 years. The battery is covered for 2 years or 500 full charge cycles, whichever comes first. Tyres, brake pads and chains are wear parts and are not covered.

A bike can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. It must be unused and in its original box. The refund is paid to the original payment method within 14 days after the bike arrives back at the warehouse. Return shipping is free for orders in the European Union.

To make a warranty claim, send the serial number and a photo of the damage to the service desk. The service desk answers within 3 working days. Damage caused by accidents or by cleaning with a high pressure washer voids the warranty. Repairs are done free of charge at an authorised workshop.
